id: 08_8. Introduction to Lasers and Laser Safety
title: 激光安全入门
source_doc: course/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/08_8. Introduction to Lasers and Laser Safety.md
author_source: project/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/08_8. Introduction to Lasers and Laser Safety/src.py

points.K10: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
points.K11: 管理控制：用制度管住流程
points.K23: 通用规则：不看、去反光、划区域
points.K24: 通用规则：专人负责、及时报告

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着激光防护眼镜，站在光学平台旁向镜头招手，门口挂着激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears laser safety goggles and waves at the camera beside an optical table, with a rectangular red laser danger signboard with a starburst pictogram on the door behind.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光安全。

shots.scene: 分类、控制、眼镜、标志四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a ladder with numbered steps, a shield, a pair of goggles and a rectangular laser danger signboard. No people.
shots.narration: 分清类别，做好控制，戴对眼镜。

shots.scene: 老周指着一台新到的大激光器，阿杰兴奋地搓手
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a newly delivered large laser in a closed housing, and the young male student rubs his hands with excitement.
shots.narration: 新激光器到了，阿杰跃跃欲试。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰一本空白的安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank safety handbook.
shots.narration: 小研说：功率高了，先学激光安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前严肃地竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 这一课，是理论部分的最后一讲。

shots.scene: 台阶图标，越往上激光器越大
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a small laser box on the bottom step and larger laser boxes on higher steps. No people.
shots.narration: 学得越深，用的激光功率越高。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标与激光束，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon facing a laser beam icon with a yellow warning triangle between them. No people.
shots.narration: 上一课说过，激光最先伤的是眼睛。

shots.scene: 六个空白卡片排开
shots.prompt_en: Six blank cards laid out in a row on a table, each with a simple icon. No people.
shots.narration: 分类、MPE、控制、标志、事故、规则。

shots.scene: 一本厚厚的空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: A thick blank standards book lying open on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 激光安全标准，规定怎样安全使用激光。

shots.scene: 书脊上的年代刻度不断延伸
shots.prompt_en: A row of blank books of growing thickness with a timeline arrow underneath. No people.
shots.narration: 美国从1969年起制定，1973年成标准。

shots.scene: 时间轴上依次亮起四个年份
shots.prompt_en: A timeline arrow with four marks lighting up one after another, each with a small book icon. No people.

shots.scene: 两本空白标准书：一本配工厂图标，一本配学校图标
shots.prompt_en: Two blank standards books: one with a factory icon, one with a school icon. No people.
shots.narration: 分行业用和教育机构用两个版本。

shots.scene: 王老师翻阅厚标准，旁边是空白证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator studies a thick blank standards book at a desk, with a blank certificate beside it.
shots.narration: 想当激光安全员，要把标准全文学透。

shots.scene: 五级台阶，最低一级亮绿色
shots.prompt_en: A five-step staircase icon, the lowest step glowing green. No people.
shots.narration: 激光按危害分级，最低的是1类。

shots.scene: 一台全封闭的设备，光束在里面看不见
shots.prompt_en: A fully enclosed instrument box with no visible beam outside, and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 光路全封闭，正常使用不会伤人。

shots.scene: 高功率激光器被装进封闭外壳，标签变绿
shots.prompt_en: A large laser box being covered by a closed protective housing, its tag turning green. No people.
shots.narration: 大激光装进封闭外壳，也能按1类管。

shots.scene: 拆开外壳的图标，标签变红
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the protective housing being opened, the tag turning red with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可一旦打开外壳，危险就回来了。

shots.scene: 一台小功率可见光激光器射出红色细光束
shots.prompt_en: A small low-power visible laser emits a thin red beam onto a white card. No people.
shots.narration: 2类是约1毫瓦的低功率可见光激光。

shots.scene: 眼睛遇到亮光自然眨眼的示意
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon blinking at a bright red dot. No people.
shots.narration: 偶尔一晃，眼睛会自然躲开。

shots.scene: 眼睛盯着光点，旁边沙漏，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon staring at a red beam with an hourglass beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但长时间盯着看，照样会伤眼。

shots.scene: 功率和时钟两个图标相加
shots.prompt_en: A power meter icon plus a clock icon equals a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害既看功率，也看照射时间。

shots.scene: 激光器上贴着黄色矩形空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A small laser box with a blank yellow rectangular caution label on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 要贴“警告”标签，很多氦氖激光是2类。

shots.scene: 大激光器和小指示激光装在同一外壳里
shots.prompt_en: A large laser housing with a small visible guide laser mounted inside the same housing. No people.
shots.narration: 对光时，别拿大功率激光直接调。

shots.scene: 红色指示光沿着反射镜一路对准
shots.prompt_en: A thin red guide beam travels along a row of mirrors and lenses on an optical table, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 先用低功率可见指示光，把光路对准。

shots.scene: 关掉指示光，再开主激光的两步图标
shots.prompt_en: Two steps: a switch turning off the small guide laser, then a key switch turning on the large main laser. No people.
shots.narration: 关掉指示光，再开主激光做实验。

shots.scene: 台阶第三级亮起
shots.prompt_en: The five-step staircase icon with the third step glowing yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 3a类，功率在1到5毫瓦之间。

shots.scene: 裸眼看光点，打绿勾；用望远镜看，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a bare eye near a beam with a green check, and binoculars pointed at a beam with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 裸眼一般不伤，用望远镜聚光就危险。

shots.scene: 一支空白激光笔
shots.prompt_en: A plain blank laser pointer lying on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 多数激光笔属于这一类。

shots.scene: 激光笔旁两种空白矩形标签，一红一黄
shots.prompt_en: Next to the laser pointer, two blank rectangular labels, one red and one yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 按辐照度，贴“危险”或“警告”标签。

shots.scene: 台阶第四级亮橙色
shots.prompt_en: The five-step staircase icon with the fourth step glowing orange. No people.
shots.narration: 3b类，5到500毫瓦，问题开始严重。

shots.scene: 光束直射眼睛图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A beam pointing directly at an eye icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不戴防护，直视光束就会伤眼。

shots.scene: 光束打到镜面，反射出一道同样亮的光
shots.prompt_en: A beam hits a flat mirror and reflects as an equally bright beam toward an eye icon, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 镜面反射的光，和直射一样危险。

shots.scene: 小研戴上激光防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on laser safety goggles before switching on a laser.
shots.narration: 用3b和4类激光，全程戴防护眼镜。

shots.scene: 激光器上贴着红色矩形空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A laser housing with a blank red rectangular danger label on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 3b类激光要贴“危险”标签。

shots.scene: 台阶最高一级亮红色
shots.prompt_en: The five-step staircase icon with the top step glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 4类在500毫瓦以上，是最高一级。

shots.scene: 光束打到粗糙表面，向四面散开
shots.prompt_en: A strong beam hits a rough matte surface and scatters in all directions toward several eye icons. No people.
shots.narration: 连粗糙表面的漫反射都能伤人。

shots.scene: 光束照到纸张冒烟起火的图标
shots.prompt_en: A strong beam hitting a sheet of paper that starts to smoke and catch fire, with a fire warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 4类激光还能引燃东西。

shots.scene: 护目镜和手套、长袖两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: laser safety goggles, and long sleeves with gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛和皮肤都要防护，贴“危险”标签。

shots.scene: 激光器上的空白类别标签特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a blank class label on the side of a laser housing. No people.
shots.narration: 激光类别看设备标签，据此定措施。

shots.scene: 三根柱子撑起屋顶：齿轮、文件夹、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Three pillars holding up a roof: a gear icon, a blank folder icon and a goggles icon. No people.
shots.narration: 控制措施分三类，像三根柱子。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍三根柱子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the three pillars one by one.
shots.narration: 3B和4类激光，三根柱子都要立牢。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 激光器外罩着完整的防护外壳
shots.prompt_en: A laser enclosed in a complete protective housing on an optical table. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制，是用硬件把危险挡住。
overlay: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 光闸挡板落下，光束被截断
shots.prompt_en: A shutter blade drops in front of the laser output and cuts the beam. No people.
shots.narration: 光闸能随时截断光束。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 衰减片让光束变细变暗
shots.prompt_en: A dark attenuator filter makes the beam behind it thinner and dimmer. No people.
shots.narration: 衰减器把功率降下来。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 门开时激光自动停止的示意
shots.prompt_en: A lab door opening with a link line to a laser that switches off automatically. No people.
shots.narration: 门联锁：一开门，激光自动停。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 门外亮着的红色警示灯
shots.prompt_en: A red warning light glowing above a closed lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 门外亮警示灯，提醒正在出光。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 光束打进黑色光束终止器
shots.prompt_en: A beam ends in a black beam dump block on the optical table. No people.
shots.narration: 光束终止器把多余的光收走。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 老李在隔壁房间看监控屏远程操作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer operates a laser remotely from a control desk with a blank monitor screen in an adjoining room.
shots.narration: 还可以远程触发、远程监控。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：用制度管住流程
shots.scene: 空白操作规程夹在实验台旁
shots.prompt_en: A blank clipboard with a standard operating procedure hangs beside the laser table. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制，是用制度管住流程。
overlay: 管理控制：用制度管住流程

shots.section_title: 管理控制：用制度管住流程
shots.scene: 门口张贴激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A rectangular laser danger signboard with a starburst pictogram posted on the lab door at eye level. No people.
shots.narration: 张贴警示标志和标签。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：用制度管住流程
shots.scene: 王老师给学生做激光安全培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 上岗前要接受安全培训。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：用制度管住流程
shots.scene: 阿杰在门口的空白登记本上签到
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank logbook at the lab entrance.
shots.narration: 进出实验室要登记。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：用制度管住流程
shots.scene: 空白实验记录本上的表格
shots.prompt_en: A blank lab notebook open on the bench with empty table lines. No people.
shots.narration: 做了哪些实验、测了什么，都记下来。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、防护服三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: laser safety goggles, gloves and a long-sleeved protective coat. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护：眼镜、手套和防护服。

shots.scene: 实验室里每个人都戴着眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student both wear laser safety goggles while working at an optical table.
shots.narration: 在场的人都要穿戴，不只操作者。

shots.scene: 三栏空白表格，每栏一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank three-column table with a gear icon, a folder icon and a goggles icon at the top of each column. No people.
shots.narration: 把措施列成一张表，一目了然。

shots.scene: 工程栏里浮现外壳、联锁、钥匙开关、警示灯图标
shots.prompt_en: Under the gear column, small icons appear: a housing, an interlock, a key switch and a warning light. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳、联锁、钥匙开关、警示灯。

shots.scene: 管理栏里浮现人物、规程、访客限制图标
shots.prompt_en: Under the folder column, icons appear: a person with a badge, a blank procedure sheet and a visitor with a stop hand. No people.
shots.narration: 激光安全员、规程、限制访客。

shots.scene: 防护栏里浮现眼镜、衣服、手套
shots.prompt_en: Under the goggles column, icons appear: goggles, a coat and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 眼镜、衣服、手套。

shots.scene: 一个天平：左边光束，右边眼睛
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a beam icon on one side and an eye icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛能承受多少光？有一条界线。

shots.scene: 界线下方绿色，上方红色
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal line on a chart: green area below the line, red area above. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫最大允许照射量，低于它才安全。

shots.scene: 波长、功率、光斑、时钟四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a rainbow wave, a power meter, a beam spot circle and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 它与波长、功率、光斑、时间有关。

shots.scene: 几个人的眼睛图标大小不同
shots.prompt_en: Several eye icons of slightly different sizes and colors in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 每个人的敏感程度也不一样。

shots.scene: 小光束配长沙漏，大光束配短沙漏，两边都是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a thin beam with a tall hourglass, and a thick beam with a short hourglass, both with yellow warning triangles. No people.
shots.narration: 弱光照久了，和强光一闪一样危险。

shots.scene: 两个苹果放在同一个秤上
shots.prompt_en: Two apples placed on the same scale, with matching blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 比较时，单位一定要一致。

shots.scene: 王老师查阅一张空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank reference table in a thick standards book.
shots.narration: 查美国标准的MPE表，按波长和时间读。

shots.scene: 表格中氦氖激光那一行被高亮
shots.prompt_en: One row of the blank table is highlighted next to a small red helium-neon laser tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如氦氖激光，查它对应的那一行。

shots.scene: 光束经过挡板后降到绿线以下
shots.prompt_en: A beam passes a shield and drops below a green line on a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 超过限值，就必须加防护措施。

shots.scene: 光束穿过一片有色玻璃后变暗
shots.prompt_en: A bright beam enters a tinted glass plate and comes out much dimmer on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 防护眼镜的镜片，靠吸收挡光。

shots.scene: 镜片内部冒出热浪线
shots.prompt_en: The tinted plate glows slightly with small wavy heat lines as it absorbs the beam. No people.
shots.narration: 被吸收的光能变成了热。

shots.scene: 薄片和厚片对比，厚片后光更暗
shots.prompt_en: Two tinted plates side by side: the thicker one lets through a much dimmer beam. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收多少，看材料，也看厚度。

shots.scene: 红光被挡，绿光却穿过同一片镜片
shots.prompt_en: A red beam is blocked by a tinted plate while a green beam passes through the same plate. No people.
shots.narration: 同一种材料，对不同波长效果不同。

shots.scene: 防护眼镜镜腿特写，刻着空白小字区
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a laser safety goggles temple arm with a blank engraved label area. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片挡光的本领，用光密度OD表示。

shots.scene: 镜腿上并排几个空白标记格
shots.prompt_en: The temple arm shows several blank marking boxes side by side, each with a small color dot. No people.
shots.narration: OD随波长变，一副眼镜常标好几段。

shots.scene: 小研拿起眼镜，对照激光器标签核对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds goggles up next to the blank label on a laser housing and compares them.
shots.narration: 用前核对：波长对上，OD够不够。

shots.scene: 台阶式的光逐级变暗
shots.prompt_en: A staircase diagram where a light beam gets ten times dimmer at each step down. No people.
shots.narration: OD每高一级，透过的光少到十分之一。

shots.scene: OD 高的镜片后几乎没有光
shots.prompt_en: Behind a dark high-density filter, only a tiny faint beam remains. No people.
shots.narration: OD为三，只透过百分之零点一。

shots.scene: 大激光器配深色眼镜，小激光器配浅色眼镜
shots.prompt_en: A large laser paired with dark goggles and a small laser paired with lighter goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 激光越强，需要的OD越高。

shots.scene: 激光、镜片、眼睛排成一线的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a laser box, a filter plate, then an eye icon in a line, with the beam getting dimmer after the filter. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片要把光压到限值以下。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白计算纸上写写算算
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator works on a blank calculation sheet with a calculator.
shots.narration: 由入射辐照度和MPE，算出最低OD。

shots.scene: 眼镜上的 OD 格高于最低线，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A goggles icon with a level indicator above a minimum line and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 所选眼镜在该波长的OD，不能低于它。

shots.scene: 三块空白矩形标志牌，颜色不同
shots.prompt_en: Three blank rectangular signboards with a laser starburst pictogram, colored red, yellow and blue. No people.
shots.narration: 常用激光标志有三种：危险、警告、注意。

shots.scene: 标志牌上的空白位置标出波长图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank signboard with a small rainbow wave icon in one corner. No people.
shots.narration: 标志上常标出激光的波长。

shots.scene: 旧式和新式两套矩形标志并排
shots.prompt_en: Two sets of blank rectangular laser signboards side by side, an older plain style and a newer style with colored header bands. No people.
shots.narration: 标志有旧式和新式两套样式。

shots.scene: 黄色牌子挂在小激光器上
shots.prompt_en: A blank yellow signboard with a laser pictogram hangs beside a small low-power laser. No people.
shots.narration: “警告”用于2类和部分3a类。

shots.scene: 红色牌子挂在大激光器旁
shots.prompt_en: A blank red signboard with a laser pictogram hangs beside a large high-power laser. No people.
shots.narration: “危险”用于部分3a、3b和4类，须强制防护。

shots.scene: 蓝色牌子立在维修现场
shots.prompt_en: A blank blue signboard stands at a temporary barrier around a laser under repair, with tools nearby. No people.
shots.narration: “注意”用于维修时的临时控制区。

shots.scene: 饼图里最大的一块是调光路图标
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart icon where the largest slice shows a mirror adjustment icon. No people.
shots.narration: 事故里，对光调试最多，占28%。

shots.scene: 高压闪电、破眼镜、没戴眼镜等小图标环绕饼图
shots.prompt_en: Small icons around the pie chart: a lightning bolt, cracked goggles, a bare face without goggles and a broken gear. No people.
shots.narration: 高压、眼镜失效各16%，非光束12%。

shots.scene: 另几块饼：没戴眼镜、故障、意外照射、维修后未恢复
shots.prompt_en: More slices around the pie chart with icons: a face without goggles, a broken gear, a surprised eye and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 没戴眼镜、故障、意外照射各8%。

shots.scene: 控制措施缺口的拼图
shots.prompt_en: A puzzle shaped like a shield with several missing pieces, and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 大多数事故，是控制措施没落实。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，旁边笑脸和大脑图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside a smiling face icon and a brain icon.
shots.narration: 端正态度，用好常识，最管用。

shots.section_title: 通用规则：不看、去反光、划区域
shots.scene: 眼睛看光束和看反射光两个图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an eye looking into a beam, and an eye looking at a reflected beam, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 规则一：不直视光束，也不看反射。
overlay: 通用规则：不看、去反光、划区域

shots.section_title: 通用规则：不看、去反光、划区域
shots.scene: 老李把台面上的金属盒、镜面物品收走
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes shiny metal boxes and a mirror-like tray from the optical table.
shots.narration: 规则二：清走不必要的反光物品。

shots.section_title: 通用规则：不看、去反光、划区域
shots.scene: 地面黄线围出激光区，门口警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A laser area marked by yellow floor lines with a curtain and a rectangular laser danger signboard at the entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 规则三：划定可控区域，张贴标志。

shots.section_title: 通用规则：不看、去反光、划区域
shots.scene: 路人在门口看到标志停步
shots.prompt_en: The older man stops at the lab door after seeing the rectangular laser danger signboard and the red warning light.
shots.narration: 让路过的人一看就知道有危险。

shots.section_title: 通用规则：专人负责、及时报告
shots.scene: 王老师胸前戴着空白工作牌，在实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator wearing a blank badge inspects the laser lab with a clipboard.
shots.narration: 规则四：懂行的人操作或现场监督。
overlay: 通用规则：专人负责、及时报告

shots.section_title: 通用规则：专人负责、及时报告
shots.scene: 王老师指出问题，阿杰点头整改
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at an uncovered beam path and the young male student nods and fixes it.
shots.narration: 通常是激光安全员，有权监督和执行。

shots.section_title: 通用规则：专人负责、及时报告
shots.scene: 电话图标和眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to an eye icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 规则五：事故立即报告，眼睛受照找眼科。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光器旁，身边浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laser box with four floating icons: fire, explosion, lightning bolt and a chemical bottle.
shots.narration: 光束之外，还有四种危害。

shots.scene: 火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A fire warning sign next to a large laser beam hitting a dark curtain. No people.
shots.narration: 火灾：4类激光能引燃物品。

shots.scene: 灯管和电容爆裂的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a high-pressure arc lamp and a capacitor bank with burst lines and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸：高压弧光灯和电容组。

shots.scene: 电源箱上的触电警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A laser power supply cabinet with an electric shock warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 触电：激光电源电压很高。

shots.scene: 染料瓶上的易燃和有毒图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank dye solution bottle with flammable and toxic pictograms beside a dye laser icon. No people.
shots.narration: 化学：染料激光的染料和溶剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在课本和实验台之间，指向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a stack of blank books and an optical table, pointing toward the table.
shots.narration: 理论学完，接下来走进实验室。

shots.scene: 三条小路通向透镜、光纤卷、激光器图标
shots.prompt_en: Three paths lead to three icons: a lens, a coil of optical fiber and a laser box. No people.
shots.narration: 还可以学几何光学、光纤和激光技术。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰戴着眼镜，在光学平台前做实验
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student, both wearing laser safety goggles, work carefully at an optical table.
shots.narration: 激光技术课，会用到3b和4类激光。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The five-step laser class staircase icon from green to red. No people.
shots.narration: 先看类别，类别越高防护越严。

shots.scene: 三根柱子：工程、管理、个人防护
shots.prompt_en: Three pillars icon: a gear, a folder and goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 工程、管理、个人防护，一个不少。

shots.scene: 防护眼镜和波长、OD 两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: A goggles icon with two green checks beside a rainbow wave icon and a filter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 照射低于MPE，眼镜OD不低于所需值。

shots.scene: 三块矩形标志和五个规则图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank rectangular laser signboards in red, yellow and blue, next to five small rule icons. No people.
shots.narration: 认清三种标志，牢记五条通用规则。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着激光防护眼镜挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing laser safety goggles waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy optical table.
shots.narration: 理论课到此结束，实验室见！
